scope: Publication integrity, source reconstruction, syntax, curated links, catalog consistency, and portable probe/controller tests. Historical model results and component evidence retain their original scope.

repository_checks.scope: Published artifact integrity, source syntax, curated local documentation links, catalog consistency, and portable probe/controller tests. No full-model or hardware validation.

engine_patch_reconstruction.method: Each complete patch applied to its base in a temporary Git index; reconstructed tree ID equals the exported source tree.

publication_content_scan.scope: All tracked and new nonignored publication files; signature-based credential/binary scan and evidence-field checks.

preserved_history_scan.scope: All reachable Git history blobs before the portfolio commit. Pattern scan for embedded credentials and binary payloads; no secret values printed.

curated_file_whitespace_check.scope: Tools, curated guides, and snapshot overview metadata. Byte-exact archived source and patches retain original formatting.

component_evidence.scope: Five cache fault-injection cases repaired and four existing context tests pass. No full-model context validation.
